symptom: `mxcli check -p` passed `call microflow M.F (Qty = '5')` for an Integer Qty, a value of the wrong enumeration, a Boolean for a DateTime, and a bare word as an argument; mx check 11.14.0 reports each as CE0117 "Error(s) in expression" at "Property 'Parameter 'Qty (Integer/Long)'' of call microflow activity 'F'"
cause: The slot table declares CallArgument.Value as ResolveBy "TargetParameter" and checkSlotKind skips every slot with a ResolveBy; nothing resolved the target, and the walker passed the bare slot without the flow or parameter. E013 (bare word) was scoped to create/change members only
insight: mx check -j names the document and the parameter of every CE0117 ("document-name": "Microflow 'C_strToInt'"), so one model with one caller microflow per case measures 94 cases in three 6 s runs instead of a model per case. Measured on 11.14.0: Integer and Long are one type (Long var to Integer and 3000000000 to Integer are clean), both widen to Decimal, Decimal (literal, variable, `div`) to Integer/Long is CE0117, String/Boolean/DateTime take only themselves, an enumeration takes only its own values (String, Integer, another enumeration's value or attribute all CE0117), object and list parameters refuse every primitive, empty is clean everywhere, and nanoflow calls behave the same. Two traps for any rule here: the flow scope records list variables as entity variables, so Object and List cannot be told apart from a variable; and a parameter written as a bare `Mod.Name` is recorded as an entity even when it is an enumeration, so the catalog has to be asked which it is. inferKind calls every [%Token%] a String, so a token anywhere but the top must make the argument Unknown. Not covered: the entity of an object argument (another entity, or [%CurrentUser%] for a non-User parameter, is CE0117; a specialization is clean)
